records.eligibility_summary: Entering freshmen at an eligible Tennessee postsecondary institution; standard route requires either a minimum 21 ACT (or concordant SAT) or a final cumulative 3.0 GPA under Tennessee rules.
records.residency_requirement: Tennessee resident under applicable state rules.
records.gpa_requirement: 3.0 final cumulative GPA is one qualifying route for eligible high school graduates.
records.test_requirement: 21 ACT composite (or concordant SAT) is one qualifying route.
records.award_amount_text: Four-year institutions and two-year institutions with on-campus housing: up to $2,250 per full-time semester as freshman/sophomore and up to $2,850 per full-time semester as junior/senior. Two-year institution award levels differ.
records.source_publisher: Tennessee Higher Education Commission / College for TN
records.notes: Award and eligibility details should be rechecked annually and when THEC publishes a new state-aid summary.

records.eligibility_summary: Need-based supplement for students who meet Tennessee HOPE Scholarship requirements.
records.income_requirement: Parents' or independent student's and spouse's adjusted gross income must be $36,000 or less on IRS tax form.
records.award_amount_text: Up to $750 per semester at four-year institutions; up to $250 per semester at two-year institutions, as a supplement to HOPE.
records.application_method: Complete the FAFSA; applies with HOPE.
records.source_publisher: Tennessee Higher Education Commission / College for TN
records.notes: Students may receive Aspire or GAMS, but not both, per Tennessee aid guidance.

records.eligibility_summary: Merit-based supplement to HOPE for qualifying Tennessee students.
records.gpa_requirement: Minimum 3.75 GPA under Tennessee's applicable calculation rules.
records.test_requirement: 29 ACT or minimum 1330 SAT; qualifying tests must meet state timing/type rules.
records.award_amount_text: Up to $500 per semester as a supplement to HOPE, including summer.
records.application_method: Complete the FAFSA; applies with HOPE.
records.source_publisher: Tennessee Higher Education Commission / College for TN
records.notes: Official page lists fall, spring and summer FAFSA receipt deadlines and specific test restrictions.

records.eligibility_summary: Scholarship, mentoring and community-service program covering eligible tuition and mandatory fees not covered by other gift aid.
records.residency_requirement: Tennessee resident under Tennessee Board of Regents classification policy.
records.award_amount_text: Variable last-dollar amount after other gift aid.
records.application_method: Complete the Tennessee Promise application, FAFSA, and ongoing program requirements.
records.source_publisher: Tennessee Higher Education Commission / College for TN
records.notes: For the Class of 2027, the official page states Promise application deadline Nov. 2 and FAFSA deadline Apr. 1 of senior year.

records.eligibility_summary: For students enrolled in a certificate or diploma program at a Tennessee College of Applied Technology; requires satisfactory academic progress and continuous enrollment.
records.residency_requirement: Tennessee resident as classified by Tennessee Board of Regents policy.
records.award_amount_text: $2,000 per academic year toward an eligible certificate or diploma program.
records.source_publisher: Tennessee Higher Education Commission / College for TN
records.notes: Official page lists trimester-specific FAFSA deadlines; retain those as policy metadata when deadline normalization is expanded.
